title: Turn a hoop at your waist
description: Keep a hoop turning around your waist for several turns.
oneStarDescription: Get the hoop turning around your waist and keep it moving long enough for someone to see.
twoStarDescription: Keep it up for several turns a watcher can count.
threeStarDescription: Catch the hoop as it drops.

title: Twist hair and pin it
description: Twist a section of hair, or a yarn stand-in, and pin it so it stays.
oneStarDescription: Twist the section. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can twist it.
twoStarDescription: Pin it so the pin lies flat.
threeStarDescription: Shake gently and say whether it stayed.

title: Untangle a chain
description: Untangle a light chain and lay it in one line.
oneStarDescription: Find one end of the chain.
twoStarDescription: Open one loop without pulling a kink tighter.
threeStarDescription: Lay the chain in one line, or say which kink remains.

title: Walk heel to toe on a line
description: Walk a straight line with the heel touching the toe of the other foot.
oneStarDescription: Walk the line once with heel touching toe.
twoStarDescription: Look forward for two steps and stay on the line.
threeStarDescription: Turn at the end and come back.

title: Whistle a two-note signal
description: Whistle two different notes as a signal and have someone copy the order.
oneStarDescription: Whistle a high one and a low one.
twoStarDescription: Repeat them in one order you chose.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone to copy the order and say whether they matched it.

title: Wrap a yarn diamond
description: Wrap yarn around two sticks so a diamond pattern shows.
oneStarDescription: Tie the sticks in a cross.
twoStarDescription: Wrap one color so the diamond starts.
threeStarDescription: Add a second color and point to the edge between them.

title: Write a palindrome
description: Write a short palindrome and show it reads the same backward.
oneStarDescription: Write a word or a short line.
twoStarDescription: Read it backward letter by letter.
threeStarDescription: If it fails, mark the letter that breaks it and fix the line or say you stopped.

title: Write a postcard that fits
description: Write a message that fits in the message area of a postcard and leave the address side clear.
oneStarDescription: Point to where the message goes.
twoStarDescription: Write a message that stays inside it.
threeStarDescription: Show the address side has no message on it.

title: Write a rhythm you clapped
description: Clap a four-beat pattern and write marks that a partner can clap back.
oneStarDescription: Clap four beats with one clear accent.
twoStarDescription: Write a mark for each clap and a gap for a silence.
threeStarDescription: Have a partner clap from the marks and say what matched.

title: Write with the other hand
description: Write your name with the hand you do not usually write with, so it can be read.
oneStarDescription: Write your name once with the other hand so the letters can be read.
twoStarDescription: Ask someone to read it, or read it yourself and mark a letter that failed.
threeStarDescription: Write one more word at the same size.

title: Send a yo-yo down and back
description: Send a yo-yo down and bring it back to your hand.
oneStarDescription: Let the yo-yo reach the end of the string.
twoStarDescription: Return it to the hand without the string knotting.
threeStarDescription: If it does not return, say whether the string or the throw failed.

title: Add a page number
description: Add a page number to a short document and show it on two pages.
oneStarDescription: Turn on page numbers. A second person can see that this step happened: turn numbering on.
twoStarDescription: Show the number on two pages.
threeStarDescription: Move the number so it does not cover the text, or say it was already clear.

title: Bind a sketchbook with a band
description: Put pages between two covers and close them with a band so they do not fall when you hold the book up.
oneStarDescription: Stack the pages between covers.
twoStarDescription: Put a band or a tie around it.
threeStarDescription: Hold it by the cover and show the pages stayed.

title: Tell a bulb from a seed
description: Point to a bulb and a seed and say one difference you can see.
oneStarDescription: Place one of each, or a photo of each.
twoStarDescription: Say a difference in size, layers, or shape.
threeStarDescription: Say which you would plant as which, from the label, or that the label is missing.

title: Burnish a clay surface
description: Rub a leather-hard clay surface until a patch turns smooth and slightly shiny.
oneStarDescription: Choose a dry enough patch that does not smear.
twoStarDescription: Rub with a smooth stone or spoon.
threeStarDescription: Show the rubbed patch beside an unrubbed one.

title: Catch with the other hand
description: Catch a soft ball with the hand you do not usually catch with.
oneStarDescription: Say which hand will catch.
twoStarDescription: Catch a gentle toss. A second person can see that this step happened: catch a toss.
threeStarDescription: Catch one toss while you take a step, or say you need to stand still.

title: Change lines on a transit map
description: On a transit map, name the station where you would change to reach a stop on another line.
oneStarDescription: Point to the start station.
twoStarDescription: Point to the station where the lines meet.
threeStarDescription: Say which line you ride first and which you ride second.

title: Check a file date before you replace it
description: Read the date on a file, then decide whether a second copy is newer.
oneStarDescription: Write the date of the file you might replace.
twoStarDescription: Write the date of the other copy.
threeStarDescription: Say which you would keep, or that the dates are not enough.

title: Clap a limerick you wrote
description: Write five short lines and clap the beats so the third and fourth lines are shorter.
oneStarDescription: Write a five-line rhyme you made up.
twoStarDescription: Clap the stresses. A second person can see that this step happened: clap the beats.
threeStarDescription: Show that lines three and four are the shorter pair.

title: Coil a small clay pot
description: Stack clay coils into a small pot that stands.
oneStarDescription: Roll one even coil. A second person can see that this step happened: roll a coil.
twoStarDescription: Stack several coils and smooth the joints enough that they hold.
threeStarDescription: Set it down and show it stands, or say which coil failed.

title: Tell a column from a pilaster
description: Say whether a vertical support stands free or is flat against the wall.
oneStarDescription: Point to a column or a flat support.
twoStarDescription: Say free column or flat against the wall.
threeStarDescription: Look from the side and say whether you can walk behind it.

title: Complete a three-by-three magic square
description: Place the digits one through nine so each row sums to the same number, and check one column.
oneStarDescription: Use each digit once. A second person can see that this step happened: place the digits.
twoStarDescription: Show the three row sums match.
threeStarDescription: Show one column matches, or fix the square.

title: Tell a cone from a needle bunch
description: Point to a cone and a bunch of needles, or say the tree shows only one.
oneStarDescription: Point to a cone or a needle bunch you can see.
twoStarDescription: Say cone or needles. A second person can see that this step happened: name it.
threeStarDescription: Find the other on the same tree or the ground beneath, or say it is not there.

title: Copy a simple border
description: Copy a short repeating border from a photo or a tile and stop where your repeat breaks.
oneStarDescription: Draw one repeat. A second person can see that this step happened: copy one unit.
twoStarDescription: Draw the unit three times.
threeStarDescription: Point to the place where your spacing slipped, or say it held.

title: Copy a fossil outline
description: Copy the outline of a fossil or a fossil photo and name one part you are not calling a species.
oneStarDescription: Draw the outline you see.
twoStarDescription: Point to one ridge, coil, or segment.
threeStarDescription: Write that you are not naming the species.

title: Count the lines of a haiku you wrote
description: Write three short lines and count the syllables, then change one line that is off.
oneStarDescription: Write three lines about something you can see.
twoStarDescription: Count the syllables in each line.
threeStarDescription: Change one line so the counts are the ones you aimed for, or say you kept a different count on purpose.

title: Count birds you can separate
description: Count birds you can tell apart in one view, without naming the species.
oneStarDescription: Count the birds you see at one moment.
twoStarDescription: Point to two that look different and count them apart.
threeStarDescription: Write the count and that the names are not claimed.

title: Count petals in fours or fives
description: Count the petals on one flower and say whether they come in fours, fives, or neither.
oneStarDescription: Count the petals you can see.
twoStarDescription: Say fours, fives, many, or neither.
threeStarDescription: Count a second bloom of the same plant, or say you have only one.

title: Count the panes in one window
description: Count the glass panes in one window and say if a bar is a frame or a reflection.
oneStarDescription: Point to one window. A second person can see that this step happened: choose the window.
twoStarDescription: Count the panes you can see.
threeStarDescription: Count again from another step and say if the number changed.

title: Cover a book corner
description: Fold a paper cover over a book or a dummy so one corner is neat and the title can still be read.
oneStarDescription: Cut a sheet larger than the cover.
twoStarDescription: Fold one corner without covering the whole title.
threeStarDescription: Open the book and show the corner stayed.

title: Deadhead one spent bloom
description: Remove one spent bloom and leave the bud below it.
oneStarDescription: Point to a bloom that is finished and a bud or leaf below.
twoStarDescription: Remove the spent bloom above the bud or leaf.
threeStarDescription: Show the bud or leaf you left.

title: Estimate a height with a pencil
description: Use a pencil at arm's length to compare a tree or a building with a known height, and say it is an estimate.
oneStarDescription: Sight a door or a person whose height you know.
twoStarDescription: See how many of those units fit the tree or building.
threeStarDescription: Write the estimate and the word estimate.

title: Expand an abbreviation you looked up
description: Find an abbreviation, look it up, and write the words, or say the source did not define it.
oneStarDescription: Point to an abbreviation.
twoStarDescription: Use a dictionary, a legend, or the document's own list.
threeStarDescription: Write the words, or write that you did not find a definition.

title: Felt a small wool ball
description: Wet and roll wool until it holds as a ball that does not pull apart.
oneStarDescription: Roll loose wool into a loose ball.
twoStarDescription: Wet it with soapy water and roll until it tightens.
threeStarDescription: Pull gently and show that it stays one piece.

title: Find a keystone
description: Point to the center stone of an arch, or say the arch has no separate center stone.
oneStarDescription: Point to the arch. A second person can see that this step happened: find the arch.
twoStarDescription: Point to the top center stone.
threeStarDescription: Say whether that stone is larger or marked, or that you cannot tell.

title: Find one constellation with a chart
description: Use a chart to find one named star pattern, then find it again with the chart lowered.
oneStarDescription: Point to the pattern on the chart and in the sky.
twoStarDescription: Find the same pattern with the chart down.
threeStarDescription: Say one star in that pattern you are not sure about.

title: Hammer a brad straight
description: Start a brad in scrap wood, move your fingers away, and drive it until the head sits near the surface.
oneStarDescription: Tap the brad until it stands on its own.
twoStarDescription: Take your fingers off before you drive it.
threeStarDescription: Drive it until the head is near the wood and say if it bent.

title: Lash two sticks together
description: Lash two sticks at a crossing so they stay when you lift one end.
oneStarDescription: Set the sticks across each other.
twoStarDescription: Wrap and tie the crossing.
threeStarDescription: Lift one end and show the other stick comes too, or say the lash slipped.

title: Level a horizon in a photo
description: Take a photo with a horizon and say whether it tilts, then take one that looks level.
oneStarDescription: Take a photo that includes the horizon.
twoStarDescription: Say which side is high, or that it looks level.
threeStarDescription: Take another and show the horizon sits level in the frame.

title: Level a measuring spoon
description: Fill a measuring spoon level with a dry ingredient and scrape the extra off.
oneStarDescription: Fill the spoon heaping. A second person can see that this step happened: fill it.
twoStarDescription: Scrape the top flat with a straight edge.
threeStarDescription: Show the flat top and say the spoon size.
